text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~ Good morning, Trainer! I've finally 
broken through the limits of Dance 
Emotion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Pearl Tango, perfected beneath the 
starry sky! A whole new form of body 
language!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to working through the night, it 
turned out simply fantastic—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh? Nnngh~~... Suddenly I'm so 
sleepy... Zzz... slee... ping...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Seeking the Pearl danced late 
into the night and didn't get proper 
rest...
